First, convert 36 weeks and 4 days to days:  
36 weeks = 36 × 7 = 252 days  
Add 4 days → 256 days total to subtract.

Date given: 1278-08-21 (assuming format is MM-DD-YYYY, so August 21, 1278).  
Subtract 256 days:  
August has 31 days, so go back to July:  
256 − 21 = 235 days left after removing August days.  
July has 31 days, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February in 1278: 1278 is not divisible by 4 (Gregorian not yet adopted, but using proleptic Gregorian: 1278 mod 4 = 2, so not leap year → Feb has 28 days).  

Count back:  
July: 31 → 235 − 31 = 204  
June: 30 → 204 − 30 = 174  
May: 31 → 174 − 31 = 143  
April: 30 → 143 − 30 = 113  
March: 31 → 113 − 31 = 82  
February: 28 → 82 − 28 = 54  
January: 31 → 54 − 31 = 23 days left in previous year (1277).  

December 1277 has 31 days: 23 days before Dec 31 is Dec 31 − 23 = Dec 8.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1277-12-08
